title: Prosper Together, Live in Unity (Long-lang Bha-lang)
cultural_context: Communal anthem and solidarity phawar reinforcing the Khasi maxim of collective welfare (Ka Bhalang), from 'Ka Phawar Beh Sbai'.
lyrics_khasi:
Lada ngi long-lang ngin man-lang,
Kawei ka dohnud kawei ka sur,
Hapdeng ki thwai, hapdeng ki lum,
Ngin ieng kum u mawsiang;
Ka jingbha jong uwei
Dei ka burom uba bun,
Kumno la bthah ki kpa,
Ngin bat da ka hok.

Phet noh ko jingiashun,
Phet noh ko jingiatai,
To wan ko jingieit
Ban pyniatylli ia ngi;
Ki khun u Hynniewtrep
Baroh ki long shibait,
Ban iatylli ka Ri
Naduh Kupli haduh Titos.
lyrics_english:
If we unite together, we shall thrive together,
One common heart, one harmonious voice,
Amid deep river pools, amid towering crags,
We shall stand firm like solid granite;
The welfare of one member
Is the honor of the entire community,
As instructed by our forefathers,
We shall uphold with integrity.

Depart, O bitter discord,
Flee away, O factional strife,
Come forth, O brotherly love,
To bind us into one whole;
Children of the Seven Huts
Are one united family forever,
Uniting all our realm
From the Kopili river unto Titos.

khasi: Kawei ka dohnud kawei ka sur,
Hapdeng ki thwai, hapdeng ki lum,
english: If we unite together, we shall thrive together,
One common heart, one harmonious voice,
Amid deep river pools, amid towering crags,
We shall stand firm like solid granite;
Is the honor of the entire community,
To bind us into one whole;
From the Kopili river unto Titos.

vocabulary.kupli: Kopili river (historic eastern boundary of Khasi realm)
